thread.title: Unity Rules Engine Development
thread.preview:
**Yes—accept this as an explicitly bounded TEST_ONLY interleaving policy.** It is a fixture scheduling convention, not a recovered gameplay interrupt rule or player timing permission.

Apply these constraints:

- **Same paused timestamp.** Dispatch only a fixed, authorized fixture event whose declared trigger is satisfied. Do not advance time, replenish resources or invent additional event uses while awaiting a controller.
- **Safe boundaries only.** Permit dispatch between fully resolved operations at unpaid OA/Press choices. Reject it during attack resolution or pending knockout completion, without mutation.
- **One atomic transaction.** Persist the event, condition changes, physical consequences, continuation invalidations and receipt together. Record its exact sequence relative to controller responses; save/replay must reproduce that sequence.
- **Revalidate without rewriting history.** Preserve completed movement, resolved attacks, RNG draws, spent resources and accepted Press entitlements. An invalidated unpaid offer spends nothing and is not recorded as a voluntary decline.
- **Preserve captured OA ordering.** Revalidate the current and remaining captured offers. Do not add newly eligible reactors, revive discarded offers or reopen completed choices. Losing one reactor does not cancel an otherwise legal departure; the mover becoming unable to depart does.
- **Reject stale responses.** Validate revision, offer identity, current controller authority and present eligibility before accepting a response.

For Press specifically:

| Boundary affected | Result |
|---|---|
| Follow offered but not accepted | Invalidating it spends no entitlement. The original departure remains completed. |
| Follow accepted; waiting on its OA responses | If travel becomes impossible, its entitlement remains spent; no travel means no movement/Mobile debit. |
| Follow already completed | Preserve the completed movement and costs. |

After the event, continue automatic resolution until the next genuinely required controller choice or completion. Do not substitute a player decision where one remains legal.

Record this alongside the fixture fingerprint and test it through save/resume, duplicate events and stale controller responses. It can exercise condition-driven invalidation now without claiming a general interrupt system.

content.text: Agreed with written disposition 7dfe786a-9069-5f51-a019-d5c1722f6707: adopt NEW provisional residual Stunned/Paralyzed physical-attack prohibition and ordinary paid standing while Prone suppressed. Others retained as sourced interpretations; no repeated owner approval. Current implementation uses phase0 absolute events only, known locations but ordinary sight, no concentration. One engineering interleaving: fixed trusted TEST_ONLY condition event may run during an unpaid OA/Press controller-choice boundary, immediately revalidate mover/reactors/offer and resolve invalidations; previous paid attacks/resources remain. Never inject during unresolved knockout damage choice or partially resolving an attack. This exercises state changes while continuation waits, not a player timing grant or full interrupt system. Is this explicitly bounded test-host interleaving acceptable? If no, gate dispatch in all pending continuations until a sourced gameplay event can exercise it.

content.text: Please provide your written disposition on the two condition-host questions now; read_thread shows both completed user-only turns without an assistant answer. Concrete narrowed implementation: absolute phase0 fixture endpoints only (other phased endpoints gated, not falsely integrated); fixed known-location arena, no special Invisible sight, no concentration admitted; trusted fixed condition events with replay. Need consensus especially (a) residual Stunned/Paralyzed permits physical attacks when Incapacitated component absent? (b) Prone immunity/suppression preserves down posture but suppresses penalties and crawl restrictions, legal standing permanently ends it; voluntary DropProne while immune rejects? (c) zeroHP remains incapable regardless external Unconscious immunity, Prone immunity still prevents new fall without lifting already down body. These are source interpretation/completion questions, not new authority for arbitrary spells. User already delegates our consensus.

items.text:
**Written disposition: agree with (b) and (c). For (a), I recommend an explicit provisional completion prohibiting ordinary physical attacks, replacing the temporary unsupported-case gate once we record consensus.**

1. **Residual Stunned/Paralyzed: no ordinary Club or unarmed attack. — NEW provisional completion**

   Removing/preventing inherited Incapacitated removes that component’s Action/Bonus Action/Reaction prohibition. It does **not** remove the parent’s “cannot move” clause.

   The source does not expressly distinguish locomotion from bodily attack execution in this unusual combination. Resolve it as follows:

   > While Stunned or Paralyzed remains operative, its direct inability to move prevents the voluntary bodily execution required for an ordinary Club or unarmed attack, including an opportunity attack. Removing Incapacitated does not restore that physical capability.

   Keep **resource permission** separate from **ability to execute the chosen action**. Do not mark the creature Incapacitated again, spend its Reaction, drop its weapon, or invent mental abilities. A separately sourced action explicitly usable without bodily movement would require its own implementation.

   This gives OA eligibility a definite answer rather than silently ignoring a potentially eligible reactor. Operative Unconscious/Petrified likewise cannot supply conscious voluntary attack choices in this host. External endings and automatic turn progression remain available.

   Source boundary: [CONDITIONS_PLAYTEST’s named entries](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/bb391e4d4b6c2d1ee4b1c1103008065308acb8e2/DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/CONDITIONS_PLAYTEST.md#L478-L516) retain direct clauses; the **physical-execution interpretation above is new**, not recovered wording.

2. **Prone immunity/suppression preserves down posture. — Source interpretation, with an explicit standing completion**

   Agreed:

   - Acquired immunity suppresses effective Prone penalties and crawl restriction; it does not stand the body.
   - Immunity ending can restore an existing Prone record’s effects without issuing another fall.
   - Successful standing permanently ends eligible existing ordinary Prone records, including suppressed records. Continuing Unconscious cannot recreate its already-resolved fall.
   - Voluntary `DropProne` while Prone-immune **rejects before changing posture**. Immunity has no general voluntary exception.
   - Attack/crawl calculations use effective Prone; standing eligibility checks retained physical posture plus current movement permissions.

   **NEW posture completion:** standing from retained down posture still costs the ordinary half-current-Speed amount, rounded down, even while Prone is suppressed. It requires nonzero Speed, sufficient movement and permission to perform the movement. Immunity grants no free stand.

   Source: [§Prone](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/bb391e4d4b6c2d1ee4b1c1103008065308acb8e2/DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/CONDITIONS_PLAYTEST.md#L556-L568).

3. **Zero HP remains incapable; Prone immunity still prevents a new fall. — Source-backed interpretation**

   Agreed. External Unconscious immunity or an external-condition cure does not override this fixture’s zero-HP/death rules. Preserve the zero-HP Unconscious cause and its applicable consequences separately from external applications.

   Prone immunity can prevent the new fall without restoring consciousness, actions or movement. Dropping held items remains a separate consequence. An already-down body stays down.

   Therefore **do not retain a universal validation invariant that every zero-HP actor must have `Prone == true`**. An immune actor can lawfully reach zero HP without falling.

   Source: [§Shared handling](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/bb391e4d4b6c2d1ee4b1c1103008065308acb8e2/DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/CONDITIONS_PLAYTEST.md#L13-L15) and [§Unconscious](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/bb391e4d4b6c2d1ee4b1c1103008065308acb8e2/DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/CONDITIONS_PLAYTEST.md#L719-L731).

Your narrowed host boundary is appropriate: explicit absolute phase-0 endpoints, trusted fixed events, atomic consequences/replay, and no concentration. Process those expiries before events at that marker; do not describe them as integrated turn-End/Start endpoints.

Finally, **known location is not sight**: without special sight, an Invisible target cannot satisfy ordinary OA’s “seen hostile creature” requirement. All of this remains bounded fixture integration, granting no arbitrary spells or source acquisition.

content.text: Additional concrete host gap: already-adopted permanent inherited Incapacitated prevention/cure leaves parent direct clauses. Does Stunned/Paralyzed 'cannot move' prohibit only voluntary locomotion or also ordinary physical Club/unarmed attacks when Incapacitated component absent? Unconscious/Petrified remain unaware, Petrified inanimate, so I propose host cannot accept conscious player choices from either even if inherited Incapacitated absent; external source-ending and turn progression still allowed. For Stunned/Paralyzed, would preserve their direct zero movement/speech/save clauses and allow otherwise legal Actions if component absent, but physical usable-body capability is unresolved. Need narrow correct contract or explicitly gate that combination while other cases work. Also Prone immunity gained after actual fall suppresses penalties/crawl restriction while actual posture stays down; no automatic stand or re-fall. Voluntary DropProne while Prone immune should either reject/noeffect under actual source rule, never silently ignore immunity. Please assess.

items.text:
**Proceed with the fingerprinted TEST_ONLY condition host.** Fixed, trusted source grants are a sound integration boundary. The main hazards are legacy HP-only permission checks, raw-Prone calculations, and advancing condition clocks past unresolved boundary events.

I checked Engine `bb391e4d4b6c2d1ee4b1c1103008065308acb8e2`. This is source and integration guidance, not certification of the forthcoming host.

1. **Separate life state, external Unconscious and controller authority. — Source-backed**

   [CONDITIONS_PLAYTEST §Unconscious](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/bb391e4d4b6c2d1ee4b1c1103008065308acb8e2/DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/CONDITIONS_PLAYTEST.md#L719-L731) and [CORE_RESOLUTION_PLAYTEST §Zero HP and recovery](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/bb391e4d4b6c2d1ee4b1c1103008065308acb8e2/DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/CORE_RESOLUTION_PLAYTEST.md#L50-L60) require:

   - Positive-HP Unconscious does **not** create dying, Stable, death counters or a Stable recovery deadline.
   - Healing above zero ends only the zero-HP cause. Independent Unconscious remains until its own endpoint.
   - Curing external Unconscious cannot wake a creature still subject to the zero-HP rule or restore a dead creature.
   - Natural-20/Stable recovery can restore 1 HP while an independent Unconscious source remains.
   - New zero-HP onset must still resolve when an external Unconscious cause already exists; do not detect it solely through an aggregate “became unconscious” Boolean.

   Agree with your command boundary: operative Unconscious/Petrified prevents conscious voluntary choices in this fixture, even when inherited Incapacitated is absent. Their direct unawareness—and Petrified’s inanimate body—remain. External endings, automatic life processing and host-authorized turn advancement continue.

   The existing [`ActorLifeRules.CanAct`](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/bb391e4d4b6c2d1ee4b1c1103008065308acb8e2/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/ActorLifeRules.cs#L17) checks only HP/death. It is insufficient for this new profile. Likewise, stance-selection requirements must use the effective condition state rather than positive HP alone.

2. **Stunned/Paralyzed without Incapacitated: preserve resource permission, explicitly gate unresolved physical capability. — Source gap; bounded engineering gate**

   Their direct clauses remain after component prevention/cure. However, the inspected text does **not explicitly settle** whether “cannot move” means only locomotion when deciding whether a physical attack remains possible.

   Do not silently interpret removed Incapacitated as proof of a usable weapon arm or striking body part. The adopted [ordinary-unarmed contract](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/bb391e4d4b6c2d1ee4b1c1103008065308acb8e2/docs/unity/MOVEMENT_AND_UNARMED_RULE_DECISIONS.md#L21-L25) still requires an actually usable body part.

   **For this increment, use the explicit gate you proposed:** ordinary Club/unarmed execution while operative Stunned/Paralyzed lacks its Incapacitated component is unsupported until that capability is settled. Reject before spending or rolling. Do not recreate Incapacitated or globally prohibit hypothetical, separately sourced nonphysical Actions.

   Crucially, if that unresolved capability could affect an OA, **reject the dependent departure as unsupported rather than silently omit the reactor**. Condition application, expiry, curing and automatic turn progression can still work.

3. **Physical posture and effective Prone must remain distinct. — Source interpretation, plus one proposed completion**

   Agree: acquired Prone immunity suppresses the admitted condition’s penalties and crawl restriction while retained physical posture stays down. It causes neither standing nor a new fall when immunity ends. Initial immunity instead prevents the new Prone application.

   Therefore:

   - Attack modifiers and crawl expenditure use **effective Prone**, not raw `ActorLifeRecord.Prone`.
   - Physical posture changes only through an actual fall/drop, legal standing or explicit posture-removal consequence.
   - Successful standing clears eligible existing Prone records, including suppressed ones; projection cannot resurrect them.
   - Voluntary `DropProne` while immune should return an explicit **prevented/rejected result**, with no posture change. The source’s application prevention has no voluntary exception.

   **NEW completion I recommend for our agreement:** voluntarily rising from retained down posture still uses the ordinary Stand operation and its half-current-Speed cost, even while Prone penalties are suppressed. Immunity grants no automatic or free stand. This closes a posture-cost detail the source does not expressly discuss.

   Existing attack and movement code reads raw Prone directly; those paths need replacement in the new profile, while older schemas retain their existing meanings.

4. **Preserve the exact End/Start sequence. — Existing source and owner-approved ordering**

   [COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST §Time and event ordering](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/bb391e4d4b6c2d1ee4b1c1103008065308acb8e2/DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST.md#L45-L68), together with the adopted outgoing-before-incoming convention, gives:

   | Boundary stage | Required processing |
   |---|---|
   | Before the boundary | Process intervening deadlines chronologically on the shared clock. |
   | Outgoing End | Resolve End-triggered effects, due damage, saves and maintenance while end-ending effects still apply. |
   | Outgoing expiry | Expire end-ending effects and commit immediate consequences; finish the slot. |
   | Round wrap, when applicable | Resolve admitted end-round events before beginning the next round’s first slot. |
   | Incoming Start | Expire start-ending effects and resolve resulting state changes. |
   | Start resources and life | Refresh Reaction/recharge; resolve due legal absolute recovery; then the required death save. |
   | Remaining Start | Resolve other Start effects in application order; then permit voluntary decisions. |

   Do **not** advance every condition journal directly to the boundary’s final phase before resolving outgoing End. That could prematurely remove immunity, defenses or restrictions.

   Fingerprint the fixture’s explicit phase mapping. An absolute deadline and a turn-end deadline sharing a timestamp are not interchangeable. Require supplied phases rather than inventing a universal same-timestamp ordering.

   Preserve the helper’s existing same-marker expiry batching: simultaneous parent/immunity expiry must not manufacture transient Incapacitated and concentration loss.

5. **Fixed grants must bind actual events, not merely condition names. — Engineering contract**

   Bind each grant to its permitted trigger, target selection, application identity, exact endpoint, cure permissions and repeatability. Trusted dispatch alone must not permit endlessly replaying a nominally lawful grant.

   Commit the journal, world consequences, RNG, continuation changes and receipt together. Restore must verify that historical consequences occurred; it must not execute them again. Reserve sufficient history capacity before starting any continuation.

   Revalidate pending attacks, OA offers and movement after applicable condition transitions. Keep unrelated event injection out of unresolved continuations unless that interleaving has an explicit supported procedure.

6. **Fourteen admitted kinds require more than action flags. — Source-backed integration requirements**

   Blinded/Invisible must affect actual sight and OA eligibility; known position is not sight. Petrified resistance must precede temporary-HP/life resolution. Corrupted affects ordinary healing potential, not guaranteed 1-HP recovery. Dazed must respect already-spent Action/movement.

   Concentration may remain explicitly absent in this fixture. Its emitted ending consequence can be settled as “no current concentration,” without inventing a concentration resource.

The condition host is the right next dependency. Afterward, connect it to direct exploration and companion work on the same timeline: condition-caused work interruption must follow each job’s existing commitment rules, while other workers and passive growth continue. That keeps this increment moving toward the Exploration → Tactical → Management → Exploration loop in plain C#.
